description: A NASA inspired space mission design game where the player goes through training and a basic mission
summary:
our game is a multi-level course that puts you through training and missions in order to simulate an astronaut's journey. our project addresses the challenge of space pollution and the lack of astronauts we have in space. this game may convince children to become astronauts so that they can contribute to space exploration and new discoveries. 

the game's primary audience is below 15 years.
details: It works as a highly fun (and educational) game. The benefits are encouraging kids to pursue their dreams of being astronauts and increasing awareness of space pollution. We used Nelify and ChatGPT to HELP us. It is creative because it helps kids learn in a fun, more-their-style way, and factors were how kids and adults would react to this game if it was educational and fun and if it was highly interactive
